package.name: san_operator_tools
package.description:
SAN v1.5 — Operator-facing utility nodes.
Adapted from skyhunter_nav_tools (Limon code). Provides: - waypoint_sender — pushes mission waypoints to current Leader, auto-follows Leader change (D-005 failover) - formation_switcher — one-shot FormationCommand publisher (column / line / wedge / diamond / custom) - swarm_dashboard — Tk GUI showing per-robot state + KPP-1 (Formation alignment) + current Tier
All adapted to use combat_robot_msgs (IDS v1.5) instead of skyhunter_msgs. Useful for PDR demonstrations and field training.
